timing: First three selected after schema inspection and before their differential analysis. Morc1 added after those first outcomes on per-mouse/raw-read source evidence, before Morc1 fitting. Exploratory and post hoc, not preregistered.

contexts.mapping: Group labels and replicate suffixes support tentative GSM aliases; no explicit library-name-to-matrix crosswalk. Omission units are matrix columns.
contexts.phenotype: Unresolved; no linked publication located; cannot establish arrest at P14.

contexts.control: GEO control; source paper WT comparator
contexts.perturbation: Hormad1&2 SFB/SFB tagged alleles, not a double knockout
contexts.mapping: Exact sample title to matrix column
contexts.phenotype: Source article reports male mid-pachytene arrest; does not independently validate every P19 sample.

contexts.mapping: Exact GEO sample description to matrix column; exclude ribofootprint columns
contexts.phenotype: piRNA-deficient context; source describes comparable tissue complexity at P16. Not equated with established arrest at sampling.

contexts.mapping: Exact GSM-specific deposited per-library file; Ensembl gene features only; seventh column is raw reads, eighth is RPKM and excluded.
contexts.phenotype: Source article describes meiotic pairing failure; GEO extraction states each library is one individual mouse. Independent phenotyping not performed.
contexts.selection_timing: Selected from the nine metadata records after the three initial contexts were fitted, based on documented counts and per-mouse libraries, before inspecting Morc1 expression outcomes.

method: Separate six-library source-gene count models (four contexts); edgeR filterByExpr, TMM, limma voom and eBayes. Refilter and renormalize full and each of six single-column omissions. No data-dependent outlier removal. BY and BH over all source genes tested within each fit, no pooled cross-context family or fixed-list FDR claim.
gene_handling: Mael: only rows with all three repeat annotations missing; repeated-element rows excluded. Native source gene IDs fitted before annotation. Hormad Ensembl to org.Mm.eg.db SYMBOL with ambiguous mappings missing; other exact source symbols retained. Only globally unique symbols may enter candidate follow-up. Morc1: retain source ENSMUSG rows and column seven raw reads, exclude RPKM, fit source IDs before unique-symbol annotation.
fixed_list: 36 frozen descriptive priorities from replicability_snapshot/stable_descriptive_priorities.csv; missing/filtered/ambiguous genes fail complete-seven-fit retention; sign <0 and magnitude <=-log2(1.5), descriptive only.
independence: Source-reported biological replicates retained, animal/pooling/pairing/batch identities not independently established. Separate sources are new contexts, not extra votes in primary family.
primary_policy: Original four-unit primary family and zero formal discoveries unchanged; no expanded confirmatory inference.
